registration.question: Can the seven gene-keyed CPTAC phospho profiles be committed beside the three RefSeq-keyed ones, with their gene keys and isoform positions resolved by a fixed rule and never guessed?
registration.what_the_14_3_percent_was: a residue-letter mismatch on the UniProt canonical (31,424 of 219,035 single-site entities whose symbol named one compiled entry), i.e. positions on another isoform; not a gene-key mismatch. The gene-key drop was separate: 8,085 single-site entities whose symbol named no compiled entry.
gene_key_rule: 1. the symbol is an HGNC approved symbol, and is no other record's previous symbol
2. else the symbol is the previous symbol of exactly one HGNC record
3. else the symbol is an alias of exactly one HGNC record
a symbol that is approved for one record and previous for another, or previous or alias for several records, is ambiguous and refused; a symbol HGNC does not know is unresolved

the record's UniProt accessions among the compiled definitions must be exactly one entry; with none, the record's Ensembl gene among the compiled definitions' genes must be exactly one entry; more than one: ambiguous, refused; none: unresolved (no compiled definition)
registration.candidate_isoforms: the UniProt canonical sequence of the compiled entry, plus every GENCODE v50 translation of the entry's Ensembl gene (its compiled genomic_origin gene, else the HGNC record's) whose CDS is complete: no cds_start_NF, cds_end_NF, mRNA_start_NF or mRNA_end_NF tag, CDS length a multiple of three after the phase, translation reaching the final codon (a stop) with no earlier stop
registration.position_rule: every candidate that carries the entity's residue letter at its position is carried onto the canonical with ptm.transfer_position (identical sequence, else the 15-residue window occurring exactly once), the canonical letter checked; one canonical position from every carrier: resolved; carriers that disagree, or one carrier with a canonical position and another without: ambiguous, refused; carriers none of which has a canonical counterpart: carried off the canonical (not joinable, not counted as unresolved); no carrier: unresolved
registration.duplicates: several entities on one canonical site in one profile: all dropped, as on 2026-09-28
registration.calibration: the same rule, symbol and position only, on the RefSeq-keyed sites whose canonical position is known from their named RefSeq protein (data/cache/cptac/mapped.json); wrong = resolved to another accession or position
registration.decoy: each gene-keyed single-site entity with a resolved gene key, its position moved by -13 and +13 residues (same letter), run through the position rule; the estimated wrong resolutions in a profile are its unresolved sites times (decoys resolved / decoys unresolved), i.e. the chance a site whose isoform is absent from the candidates is carried by a candidate at that position anyway

gates_meaning.G0: pooled over the four RefSeq-keyed profiles; if it fails the rule is not fit and all seven profiles are retired
gates_meaning.G1: the 2026-09-28 units check, recomputed on the profile's resolved sites on curated phospho sites; known before this registration: brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018 sat at -0.518 under the canonical-only mapping
gates_meaning.G2: unresolved / single-site entities with a resolved gene key; the bound is the 2026-09-28 gene_keyed_mismatch_bound (0.02), unchanged, and the unresolved count is that registration's mismatch measured against every candidate isoform instead of the canonical alone
gates_meaning.G3: estimated wrong resolutions / sites resolved to a canonical position

registration.not_gated: gene keys that are ambiguous or unresolved cost coverage, not correctness: every one is listed with its entity count, and its share is reported; ambiguous sites are refused and counted
registration.committed: a profile passing G0 to G3 is committed: its resolved sites on curated phospho sites get relative_abundance_in_tumours from that study, as for the three RefSeq-keyed profiles (tumours with a value, median log2 ratio to the study's pooled reference; values summarised in memory, never per tumour in the repository); a profile failing any gate is retired: counted, not committed
registration.wording_committed: {profile}: committed. Gene keys by the registered HGNC rule; positions carried from the isoform that carries the residue onto the UniProt canonical: {resolved} of {sites} single-site entities resolved, {unresolved} unresolved ({unresolved_rate}), {ambiguous} ambiguous, estimated wrong resolutions {estimated_wrong_rate}. Values are relative abundance measured in that study's tumours, not occupancy, not in a person.
registration.wording_retired: {profile}: retired, not committed: {failed}. Its sites stay counted only; the gene-keyed positions cannot be placed on an isoform under the registered rule closely enough to commit.
registration.expected: colon 2019 (canonical mismatch 4.3%) the likeliest to pass G2; breast 2020 and endometrial 2020 uncertain; the four TCGA quantifications (canonical mismatch 16.2% to 19.2%, RefSeq of about 2013) likely to fail G2 because GENCODE v50 lacks some of their isoforms; TCGA breast PanCan likely to fail G1 as before. No coverage expectation is registered.

reproduced_before_registration.gene_key_drops: 8,085 single-site entities, 498 distinct symbols, none naming several compiled entries (all named none)
reproduced_before_registration.note: docs/PROTEIN.md gives 219,179: the same count before the 144 duplicate-site drops; both round to 14.3%

entry_script.why: argv[0] is a file inside this repository that git tracks and reports unmodified: the commit holds the code that wrote the bytes, so a rebuild can run it. The only clean form
entry_script.forms_are_decided_in_advance: genomeos.manifest.ENTRY_FORMS: one clean form (a tracked, unmodified file inside this repository), every other form refuses, and a form that cannot be classified is 'unknown' and refuses too. Read from sys.argv[0] at write time, never declared

code_cleanliness.counting_path_is_computed: the transitive import closure of this script, computed from the files' import statements at write time (genomeos.manifest.counting_path), never by importing: it follows every import that resolves to a file in this repository rather than only the package, counts the __init__.py of each package above a module, resolves bare imports against the directories the source literally puts on sys.path as well as the repository root, and matches every path component against what its directory lists, so a class name such as genomeos.genome.Genome cannot enter it as a file; not a hand-written list
code_cleanliness.note: several lanes work in this one checkout. A file under foreign_uncommitted_code belongs to another lane; this lane did not write it and did not commit it. The counting path is the computed closure above, so a foreign file outside it cannot have entered a number here, and foreign_uncommitted_code_on_the_counting_path names any that could

revision_stamps.sampled: code_cleanliness.git_sha is read while the writer computes; code.git_sha is read when the result is written. Both are HEAD of the same checkout at two moments
revision_stamps.reading: no revision race: both stamps record 39c7ccc

traced_inputs.note: Every file this writer opened for reading under data/ was recorded by an audit hook on the "open" event, canonicalised through data/'s links so one file has one spelling, and compared against the inputs the manifest declares; a member of a declared group counts as declared and hashed on its own, a file under a declared directory counts as declared by prefix. The hook is per interpreter, so a file read by a subprocess is not in this record, nor is one reached through a path that canonicalises to neither this checkout's data/ nor one of its link targets.
